title: Party-parity Shape-B row (intermediate per-event per-AC adapter output)
description: ONE ROW of the canonical Shape-B intermediate format every per-event parity adapter materialises before the per-constituency Compare-Aggregator (backend/yen_gov/canonical/recon/event_aggregator.py) sees them. Created by PR-S-TN-AE2026 of the 2026-06-10 electoral-data-quality + party-catalogue plan. The shape-B CSV lives under datasets/ephemeral/party-parity/state=<slug>/<event>/<sha>/shape-b.csv per CLAUDE.md section 3 ephemeral tier; NOT a long-format canonical CSV under datasets/data/ and NOT walked by Tier-B. This schema documents the row-shape contract (CSV-column-contract style: each column declares name + dtype + nullability); adapters MAY validate each emitted row against this schema via jsonschema, and read_shape_b_csv (backend/yen_gov/canonical/recon/shape_b.py) enforces the same header invariants in-process. The 10 fields are fixed by the PR-S-TN-AE2026 brief; field rename / removal is a MAJOR schema bump per CLAUDE.md section 11.

x-changelog.description: Initial schema for the Tier-C per-event parity Shape-B intermediate row (PR-S-TN-AE2026 of TODO/20260610-electoral-data-quality-and-party-catalogue-plan.md). Ten fields per the brief: external_scope (adapter registered id; distinct values count as distinct oracles in the per-event aggregator, required), external_vintage (ADR-0042 operator snapshot window pin: YYYY, YYYY-MM, YYYY-MM-DD, OR an ECI event id like 'AcGenMay2026' when the adapter pins to event-id grain, required), state (kebab-slug state id from entities/geo.csv, required), event (ECI event id from sources/eci/events.py, required), constituency_no (1-based ECI eci_no within the state, required integer), constituency_name (publisher constituency name as published, required), winner_party_id (canonical parties.IN.<SLUG> the adapter resolved this source's winner to; may be parties.IN.UNK per CLAUDE.md section 10 no-silent-demotion, required), winner_party_short_raw (publisher's raw party label, required), winner_candidate_name (publisher's raw winner name, required), winner_votes (publisher's winner-side total votes; nullable when publisher doesn't report counts). Wired into recon/shape_b.py ConstituencyParityRow + write_shape_b_csv + read_shape_b_csv; event_aggregator.py compare_event() consumes the resulting list. Schema is reference-only (shape-B files live under datasets/ephemeral/, not walked by Tier-B); adapters may opt into per-row jsonschema validation.

external_scope.description: The source-family identifier the adapter is registered under in recon.adapters.EVENT_REGISTRY (e.g. 'yen-gov-elections' | 'thecont1-state' | 'tcpd-state'). The per-event Compare-Aggregator treats DISTINCT external_scope values within one (state, event, constituency_no) group as DISTINCT oracles when computing n_oracles_present. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

external_vintage.description: Upstream snapshot pin per ADR-0042 (CLAUDE.md section 12). Adapters that pin to a calendar snapshot use YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD; adapters whose row identity is the per-event observation MAY use the ECI event id directly (e.g. 'AcGenMay2026') since the event id IS the publisher-edition anchor for that observation grain. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

state.description: State slug from datasets/data/entities/geo.csv (e.g. 'tamil-nadu', 'west-bengal'). Same slug the on-disk datasets/elections/<kind>/state=<slug>/ partition uses. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

event.description: ECI event id registered in backend/yen_gov/sources/eci/events.py (e.g. 'AcGenMay2026', 'LsGenJun2024'). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

constituency_no.description: 1-based ECI eci_no within the state. Comparable across sources because every Indian AE/PC publisher reports the same eci_no scheme per the delimitation-order shared base. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: false.

constituency_name.description: Publisher's published constituency name (e.g. 'GUMMIDIPOONDI'). Carried verbatim for the curator; NOT used as a comparison key (publishers differ on casing / spelling). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false (empty string acceptable).

winner_party_id.description: Canonical yen-gov party_id (parties.IN.<SHORT_SLUG>) the adapter resolved this source's winner to. MAY be 'parties.IN.UNK' when the publisher's label has no canonical alias (CLAUDE.md section 10 no-silent-demotion). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false.

winner_party_short_raw.description: Publisher's raw party label for the winner (e.g. 'ADMK', 'All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam'). Carried verbatim into the verdict CSV's other_sources column for curator review. CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false (empty string acceptable for NOTA / IND rows where the raw label was elided).

winner_candidate_name.description: Publisher's raw winner candidate name. The per-event aggregator compares this case-insensitively after stripping common punctuation (event_aggregator._normalise_name). CSV-column-contract dtype: string, nullable: false (empty string acceptable for NOTA rows).

winner_votes.description: Publisher's winner-side total votes (EVM + postal where the publisher reports them separately). Used ONLY for the curator's review column; NEVER a verdict input (publishers differ on EVM-only vs EVM+postal). Nullable for publishers that don't report a vote count. CSV-column-contract dtype: integer, nullable: true.
